Sandbox_KnoxDetectionKit_KitRarity_toolt: Controls how often the detection kit spawns in loot. Common = 2x spawn rate, Uncommon = 1x (default), Rare = 0.4x, Very Rare = 0.15x. Found in hospitals, clinics, and military facilities. Changes take effect after a server restart.
Sandbox_KnoxDetectionKit_WaitMinutes_too: In-game minutes before blood test results appear (0-1440). Default: 120 (about 2 in-game hours). Set to 0 for instant results. The kit is consumed immediately — only the result is delayed.
